**Hochschild and cyclic homology of quantum groups**

*Ping Feng1'* and Boris Tsygan2'***

42 pp, 12 sections.

**Abstract.** For an arbitrary complex linear semisimple Lie group G, we consider Hopf algebras of the deformations of the formal and algebraic functions on G. The Hochschild and cyclic homology of these Hopf algebras are computed when the value of the deformation parameter is generic. Table of Contents
